# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Flynn Estate Agents are delighted to present Apartment 14, Block A, The Weir, a spacious and well-located two-bedroom apartment in the heart of Chapelizod village. Positioned on the first floor and extending to approximately 64 sq m / 689 sq ft, excluding the balcony, the apartment offers an excellent layout with two double bedrooms, two bathrooms, a private balcony and designated car-parking…
